verdict.rationale: Otter's marketing page mentions 'Live transcription in multiple languages' but there is no detail on which languages, whether summaries are also multilingual, or how mid-meeting language switching is handled; community evidence only discusses English-accent accuracy, not multilingual performance. missing for 10: list of supported languages, evidence that summaries (not just transcription) work in other languages, handling of language switching within a meeting, independent corroboration of non-English accuracy.
